name: Casa Lavanda
address: Ulupelit Köyü, Seçilmiş Sokak No:2, Şile, 34980, Istanbul
dinnerNote: Tasting menu for the whole table; à la carte also served
dinnerNoteTr: Tadım menüsü, masadaki tüm misafirlere servis edilir; alakart menü de mevcut

menus.name: Tadım Menüsü (tasting menu)
menus.note: Snacks from the garden, then seven courses; served only when the whole table orders it. Eight-glass wine pairing TRY 4,500. VAT included.

alsoTry.name: Lavanta Lounge Bar
alsoTry.note: The hotel's bar, overlooking the garden, serves a snack menu and cocktails from 11:30am to 11pm.

hotel: Casa Lavanda, a 16-room boutique hotel in the village of Ulupelit near Şile
bookingOpens: Online through the restaurant's Check&Place booking page, or by phone.
children: Children are welcome only at Sunday lunch, brunch and special events, between 1pm and 5pm in spring and summer; hotel guests must be 12 or over.
